regressionNote: No changes since last audit (a65dbf0). File is unchanged.

noUnboundedLoops.notes: Only loop is `for (uint256 i = 0; i < 11; i++)` in setRoute — bounded to constant 11.

checkedArithmetic.notes: Solidity 0.8+; no unchecked blocks or assembly.

reentrancyGuarded.notes: CurveAMMAdapter is stateless during swap execution. It holds no token balances and makes no state-changing calls that could be exploited via re-entry. forceApprove resets before each router call.

accessControlled.notes: setRoute is onlyOwner. swap() is open to any caller — authorization is enforced by callers (strategy).

initializerProtected.notes: Not an upgradeable proxy. Constructor is the sole initializer.

summary: Concrete IAMMAdapter that routes token swaps through the Curve Router NG. Stores one pre-computed route struct per (tokenIn, tokenOut) direction. Enforces a bidirectional-configuration invariant: swap() in either direction reverts until BOTH directions are configured. Route management is owner-only. The contract is stateless between calls (no token balances held).

keyStateVariables.name: router
keyStateVariables.invariant: Set once at construction; cannot be changed. Points to the Curve Router NG address.

keyStateVariables.name: routes
keyStateVariables.invariant: Route.configured must be true for swap() to succeed. Both directions must be configured before either can be used.

externalEntryPoints.function: setRoute(address tokenIn, address tokenOut, address[11] path, uint256[5][5] swapParams, address[5] pools)
externalEntryPoints.notes: Validates path[0] == tokenIn and last non-zero path entry == tokenOut. Does NOT validate swapParams or pools content — must be verified off-chain against actual Curve pool coin indices.

externalEntryPoints.function: swap(address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint256 amountIn, uint256 minAmountOut) returns (uint256 amountOut)
externalEntryPoints.notes: Open to any caller. Authorization is the caller's responsibility. Pulls tokenIn FROM caller, sends tokenOut BACK to caller (via router receiver=msg.sender). Bidirectional invariant: requires both routes[tokenIn][tokenOut] and routes[tokenOut][tokenIn] to be configured. forceApprove (reset-then-set) prevents allowance accumulation.

externalEntryPoints.function: getRoute(address tokenIn, address tokenOut) view returns (address[11], uint256[5][5], address[5], bool)
isPairFullyConfigured(address tokenA, address tokenB) view returns (bool)
externalEntryPoints.notes: Returns true only if both A->B and B->A routes are configured.

externalCalls.notes: Assumes standard ERC20. safeTransferFrom pulls from caller; forceApprove sets exact amountIn on router. No fee-on-transfer or rebasing token support.
Router receives exactly amountIn tokens. Output is sent directly to msg.sender (strategy). If router reverts, approval is also reverted.

trustAssumptions: router is the genuine Curve Router NG at the configured address.
tokenIn is a standard ERC20 (no hooks, no fee-on-transfer).
Route data (path, swapParams, pools) is correctly pre-computed off-chain against live pool coin indices.
The Curve Router NG pulls exactly amountIn and does not re-enter the adapter.
